observed_baseline.provenance: Start times observed via Get-Process; output/manifest times are actual filesystem/generated timestamps. Observational current-worktree timing, not an approved Product SLO or controlled benchmark.

finding: Next calls ReadinessReasons for every nonterminal work item and repeats HasRequiredCommittedState for identical prerequisite/effective-state inputs. Function depends only on loaded prerequisite, repository and effective state; it has no dependent-consumer-specific semantics.
correction: A dictionary lives only inside one Next invocation and is keyed by prerequisite identifier plus effective state. Cache both successful and failed source checks for that assessment; preserve every consumer reason. Never static/persistent or shared across commands. Own gate checks remain direct. Re-run missing/stale/dirty/wrong-scope tests across separate invocations and distinct-key alias cases.
boundary: No source gate skipped, weakened, or made durable. No Product policy/lifecycle/merge bypass; historical closure remains immutable.
